name: Ōe (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Ōe town emblem in white: a stylised angular character with wing-like strokes and a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Ōe, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 12 August 1969.

features.role: Ōe town emblem — a stylised angular character with wing-like strokes and a ring
